## T179-Pd.3b selected engineering subcontract — genuine HOT source custody (2026-10-16)

- [ ] T179-Pd.3b: close and implement actual original-producer lineage → accepted Ready read/consumption witness → exclusive prepublication attempt with the accepted observed-original reader. This is the first concrete dependency of submitted-current admission; it does not claim automatic/output semantic admission, S, durable P/A/history, M3 or F1. Continue the full source/policy work after qualification, without an ordinary technical permission stop.
- Root and separate architecture author traced the real source: StagePlayerTurn1561 creates the actual ordinary original and final request; WaitForContractRepair reads Ready at3460 and consumes it at3566, with separate real read/delete leases. Existing FS text reads already derive from physical snapshots; preserve one final read's bytes/text/dispatch/hook/decoding rather than substitute a second read. Accepted read and known deletion+release are different outcomes; absence, loss of return or uncertainty cannot prove consumption. Historical origin/Ready facts never reuse an ended lease capability; observed original evidence is issued under the actual current publication lease.
- Genuine continuation/reservation can precede this capture: CreateJointRepairPreparation134–208 reconstructs the held graph and current guards without the automatic INACTIVE gate. The INACTIVE/original-equality guard is later in MechanicalAdmission115–145. Therefore no new reservation family is currently justified for this contour. Generic validation199 is not already full source acceptance: canonical joint dispatch809/849 returns through its dedicated postpublication route. All upstream raw/player/level/time checks and seven-output-root/73-leaf closure still need shared source-aware policy integration.
- Required contract boundaries: actual Stage issuer (no source-label/parsed-frame mint), actual accepted Ready producer before deletion, same owner/lease/G/original/continuation/reservation, no earlier native attempt/uncertainty, closure faults/abort/pending-debt/reentry and exact cleanup. Distinguish native-unattempted status from the private CAPTURING gate: no new S/B may attach after any existing prepared/cache/common seal. Missing hot lineage on old/helper/cold routes does not break or upgrade existing v2. Browser historical issuance never revives a disposed scope; current main/browser admission remains real. Worker-direct v2 policy remains unchanged; missing new proof cannot become a blanket worker rejection. The author is finishing an exact implementable bounded contract, not granting full source/cold authority.
- Fresh autonomous-start f0441081b was independently cloned from GitHub into a new empty directory:986exactselectedfiles/clean/noalternates/mainunchanged/no restoredruntime; receipt retained here. New product code/tests/runtime remainUNRUN. Existing131PASS accepted packets are not repeated without an actual changed dependency. Independent Astra/XHigh engineering review, causalTDD and freshG5/SOURCE/FIRSTLate2/EVIDENCE gates are required before this stage's actuals. Same action/turn/time/no replay and all F1/T197/D4/guided/visual/Windows/D8 restrictions remain.
